Your brain is sending out a signal right now.

Kevin explains how a device worn on the head lets a thought move a ball. He says it shows your brain broadcasts.

Then he shares what happened when he wore it: the ball shot across the room like it came out of a gun. When people asked how, his answer was that he broadcast stronger, with more intensity, at a higher frequency.

How strongly do you hold the thoughts you want to come true?
